protocol.delta_prediction: predicted future state minus current state; identical absolute error
protocol.input_capture: after selecting the proposed action, before env.step
protocol.selection_metric: equal-weight mean of goal MAE and modulator MAE
protocol.data_split: disjoint entire episodes; no cross-episode labels
protocol.continuation: frozen Q, epsilon zero, existing randomized tie resolution
protocol.limits: on-policy forecasts only; overlapping windows; bootstrap resamples whole test episodes
protocol.deployment: diagnostic experiment; no neural action selection
protocol.point_estimate_gate: neural goal and modulator MAE each beat every baseline in every split
